After-Hours Automation: Automated texts sent outside 7 AM–7 PM CST, informing leads office is closed; follow-up tasks created for next business day.
Contact and Opportunity Creation: Phone mandatory, email optional; tags added for contact types and languages to aid lead tracking and case manager assignment.
Clio Manage Integration: One-click sync for contacts and matters; Dropbox folders auto-created per client for storing documents; manual upload links used.
